_why: R32 weather timings (fade 40s, spells 4-12 min) and per-biome weather tables from tasks/R32-round.md and tasks/R32-01-weather-core.md.

_biomes_why.plains: Temperate home grasslands: mostly clear (0.7) with occasional rain (0.25) and light morning fog (0.05).
_biomes_why.forest: Temperate woodland matching plains weather mix: mostly clear (0.7), periodic rain (0.25), rare fog (0.05).
_biomes_why.desert: Arid dunes: mostly clear sun (0.65) interrupted by harsh sandstorms (0.35), never rain or snow.
_biomes_why.snow: Frigid boreal snowfield: frequent snowfall (0.6), clear cold breaks (0.35), and rare freezing fog (0.05).
_biomes_why.mountains: Alpine ridges: heavy snow (0.5), clear alpine skies (0.4), and cloud-level fog (0.1).
_biomes_why.swamp: Damp boggy wetlands: persistent fog (0.45) and frequent rain (0.35), with brief clear spells (0.2).

clear._why: Baseline clear sky: full visibility, no fog pull-in, no noise masking, gentle 1 m/s breeze.

rain._why: Steady rainfall: moderate fog pull-in (0.75), slightly reduced visibility (0.8), rain patter masks footsteps (0.35), grey-blue tint.

snow._why: Steady snowfall: denser haze (0.6 fog), 0.7 visibility, muffled acoustics (0.2 noise mask), crisp white flakes.

sandstorm._why: Severe desert gale: heavy fog pull-in (0.3), low visibility (0.4), roaring wind masks half of noise (0.5), 9 m/s wind, dense sand grit.

fog._why: Thick still mist: strong fog pull-in (0.4), halved visibility (0.5), calm 0.5 m/s air with no falling particles, damp grey-green tint.
